navigation_regression.scope: Guard editor assignment and dirty reset by the render, route, location, token and instance that initiated posts.get. Later reads cannot change a newer editor or its save destination.

source_boundary: Selected public source contains no credential patterns, private host paths, runtime artifacts or symlinks. Fictional fixtures and unchanged original public images only. Bounded scan, not an independent security audit.
limits: Only current saved and published snapshots; no historical graph or unsaved input
Canonical article routes shared with posts.check; external URLs, raw HTML, code and images excluded; anchors unverified
One hop; 1000 snapshots, 8 MiB Markdown, 20000 references, 2000 per source, 100 groups per list and 3 source positions per group
Counts describe checked snapshots; truncated and omitted counts mark incomplete results
Old aliases with multiple owners remain unresolved; current published slug takes priority
Reports are catalog snapshots; another writer can make them stale
Studio links open the current saved draft by ID; positions retain the actual source revision
Linux Chromium verified; other browser engines not verified
Prior vulnerability database HTTP 403 and missing trusted historical v0.1 executable remain outside this feature acceptance
